name: The majority voted in favour of [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-08-22.158.1) introduced by Victorian Senator [Lidia Thorpe](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/lidia_thorpe), which means they will now be included in the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 21, page 23 (line 5), omit "5", substitute "6".* > > *(2) Clause 21, page 23 (line 8), omit "6", substitute "7".* > > *(3) Clause 23, page 24 (after line 13), after paragraph (2)(d), insert:* > >> *(da) 1 other Board member with expertise or experience, professional credibility and significant standing in any of the fields mentioned in paragraph (3)(i); and* > > *(4) Clause 23, page 24 (line 14), omit "3", substitute "2".* > > *(5) Clause 23, page 24 (line 17), omit "and (d)", substitute ", (d) and (da)".* > > *(6) Clause 23, page 24 (line 32), omit "engagement,".*
